item: Resume and model controls where the task happens (lane-m-routes)
key_paths: src/api/jobs.py; src/api/llm.py; src/jobs/llm_bulk_queue.py; src/static/app-core.js; src/static/taskmanager.js; src/static/app-ai-tools.js
summary: The low-memory pause names itself (it read as idle) and carries its own Resume in both task managers; imported articles waiting for keywords are one task-manager row with Resume (refused under an import/restore hold; read at most every 30 s); Settings > Models gains Free the GPU and Stop Ollama (only a daemon this app started), each pausing a queued summary/translation run at its article boundary before the model is freed (R669); the vLLM Install button shows the measured disk/RAM cost before the click. Tests: tests/test_model_and_pause_controls.py + model_and_pause_controls_node_test.js.
